theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (J : Eucl n → ℝ) (φ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (w : Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → w ∈ Ω → Continuous Φ → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ Ω, ∀ v' ∈ Ω, c * ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖Φ v - Φ v'‖) → Continuous J → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ v in Ω, J v * φ (r⁻¹ • (Φ v - Φ w))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ s, J w * φ (fderiv ℝ Φ w s)))
